steps.note: typing: no vim layers, the base layer's letters
the combo that puts the editor in vim mode
NORMAL: the board flips to commands
h — left, on the right index home
l — right; h j k l under four fingers, not QWERTY's accident
w — word motion, on the other hand
y — yank, a combo on j and k
v — the combo on i and a; still NORMAL while it is pressed
VISUAL stacks on NORMAL: the motions still fall through
Esc — b and e on the vim layer — ends the selection
back in NORMAL; i opens INSERT (a would too)
INSERT: the vim layers step aside, the letters come back
Esc again — b and m now, the same two keys on Alpha 1
out of the editor: no vim layers at all
